project_type: Next.js 14 TypeScript multi-tenant SaaS CRM with Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL
build_system: npm/pnpm with Next.js build, vitest for testing
test_framework: vitest with tests/unit/ directory, vitest.setup.ts, path aliases via @/
verification_instructions: Run typecheck, then run unit tests. Both must pass.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No running database available - validation via typecheck and unit tests only.
contribution_requirements: Branch fix/critical-app-scan-3 from main. Commit with descriptive messages.
key_patterns: API routes in app/api/tenant/, lib/ for business logic, components/tenant/ for UI, Zod schemas in lib/api/schemas/, requireAuth + requirePerm for auth, vitest mocking patterns in tests/unit/
directory_structure: app/api/tenant/ - API routes, lib/ - business logic, components/ - React components, tests/unit/ - unit tests, drizzle/ - DB schema
